==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Scout''' is one of the most commonly used towers in various official game images and videos, such as [[Thumbnails]] or [[Trailers]].
*The Level 3+ armor that the Default and {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} uses is the [[w:c:r2da:Scout|Scout armor]] from R2DA.
*The Level 0-2 {{Color|Premium|Intern}} shirt has a line of code that says "''print("Hello world!")''", which is a reference to Roblox's coding language Lua.
*The {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin is based on [[w:c:roblox:Guest|Guests]].
**When upgraded to Level 4, the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin will have a speech bubble appear above it, which is a reference to the [[w:c:roblox:Chat#Filtering|Super Safe Chat]] feature that was once usable by [[w:c:roblox:Guest|Guests]]. It can say one of the following messages:
***"''I like your style''"
***"''I can only use quick chat!''"
***"''Hello''"
***"''Hi''"
***"''Go to sleep''"
***"''Happy trails''"
***"''Happy Easter''"
***"''What's new?''"
***"''Thanks for playing''"
***"''Wanna be friends?''"
**The weapon it wields are the same weapons used by the Default '''Scout''' between the 13th of October 2019 and the 6th of April 2020.
*The {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin is the first skin in the game to have a placement animation.
**This animation, similarly to the rest of the skin, is a reference to old Roblox.
*Interestingly, when the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} '''Scout''' is selected to be placed, the text at the top of the green bar says "Guest 1457". However, when placed down, the number switches to 10.
*The {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin's shooting sound is a distorted version of the default [[Commander]]'s Level 0-3 shooting sound.
*Multiple old versions of '''Scout's''' skins and the current {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin use this [https://www.roblox.com/library/4372594/Pistol mesh] for their HK P2000 pistol.
*The {{Color|Hexscape|King of Rock}} skin is based on the singer and actor [[wp:Elvis Presley|Elvis Presley]], who was called the "''King of Rock and Roll''".
*During [[The Classic Event]], the equipped '''Scout''' in the pre-loaded loadout in [[Classic Castle]] had the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin equipped by default.
**This no longer occurs if you activate [[Classic Castle]] through [[Sandbox Mode]].

===Roblox Catalog===
*The Default, {{Color|Basic|Red}}, {{Color|Basic|Green}}, {{Color|Basic|Blue}} and {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} skins' cap is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|13746089|French Brimmed Cap}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Default, {{Color|Basic|Red}}, {{Color|Basic|Green}}, {{Color|Basic|Blue}}, {{Color|Premium|Black Ops}}, {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}}, {{Color|Party|Party}} and {{Color|Golden}} skins' shades are the {{RLinkC|4507911797|Sleek Tactical Shades}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 2-3 version 2 and 3 {{Color|Golden}} fedora is the {{RLinkC|1285307|Sparkle Time Fedora}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 2-3 version 3 {{Color|Basic|Survivor}} hat is the {{RLinkC|99851490|Errday Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**This accessory was also used by the Level 2-4 version 2 {{Color|Basic|Survivor}} skin and the Level 5 version 1 {{Color|Basic|Survivor}} skin.
*The Level 2-5 version 1 and 2, and Level 2-4 version 3 of the {{Color|Basic|Survivor}} scout skin use the {{RLinkC|57684660|Ninjafaic}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 5 version 2 and Level 4 version 3 {{Color|Golden}} guns are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|130113146|Hyperlaser-Gun}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*The original Level 5 Default helmet is the {{RLinkC|134845666|Operation Jungle Anticyclone}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The original Level 5 {{Color|Basic|Red}}, {{Color|Basic|Green}} and {{Color|Basic|Blue}} skins used a re-textured version of this accessory.
*The Level 2-3 version 3 {{Color|Premium|Black Ops}} cap is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|13334984|Summertime 2009 R&R&R cap}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**This accessory was also used by the Level 2-4 version 2 {{Color|Premium|Black Ops}} skin and the Level 5 version 1 {{Color|Premium|Black Ops}} skin.
*The cap worn by the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} skin is the {{RLinkC|48474313|Red Roblox Cap}} from the Roblox catalog.
*The {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin, being a skin partially themed around older Roblox contains many accessories from it.
**The destroyed crown worn it at Level 4 is a modified version of the {{RLinkC|1125510|The Void Star}} accessory.
**The skull worn by it is the {{RLinkC|36883367|Skull}} accessory while its skeleton torso comes from the {{RLinkBU|295|Skeleton}} bundle.
